activity.notes: Symon Petliura became head of the Directory of the Ukrainian People's Republic on 11 February 1919. This Activity models the territorial-state phase through 1920, when the UNR government and army were forced into exile. His subsequent leadership of the UNR government-in-exile is recorded as a separate Activity.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Petliura, Symon
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Ukraine states that Petliura succeeded Volodymyr Vynnychenko as president/head of the Directory on 11 February 1919 and led the UNR through the subsequent war.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Directory of the Ukrainian National Republic
sources.citation_text: The Directory entry confirms Petliura became its head on 11 February 1919 and later held the republic's supreme authority.
